failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, settings-files)
failed_jobs.reason: Job failed with a generic 'Process completed with exit code 1' annotation and job logs were unavailable ('Failed to fetch logs for job'). The PR only changes tests/Aspire.Hosting.Dotnet.Tests/* (DotnetProjectResourceTests.cs and its csproj), which is unrelated to the VS Code extension or its E2E test infrastructure. This matches a recurring pattern of intermittent VS Code extension E2E failures with generic exit codes and no retrievable logs seen on other shards/platforms.
